name: ech-claim-check
description: Turn-end claim check: at Stop and SubagentStop, Haiku reads the final text and the turn's tool calls and re-prompts once when a success, fix, count or "verified" claim leaves the turn unchecked. Ships an opt-in claim-sentinel observer agent.

rulesFile.title: Project rules file
rulesFile.description: Optional file whose text is appended to the Haiku prompt when it exists. Relative paths resolve against the session's working directory; ~/ is your home.
